# Case 1: simple 3x3 symmetric distances, k=1
{"k":1,"dist":[[0,1,2],[1,0,3],[2,3,0]]}
@ Expected knnIdx and knnDist for k=1
{"idx":[[1],[0],[0]],"dist":[[1],[1],[2]]}

# Case 2: 3x3 distances, k=2
{"k":2,"dist":[[0,1,2],[1,0,3],[2,3,0]]}
@ Each point connects to two nearest neighbors
{"idx":[[1,2],[0,2],[0,1]],"dist":[[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]]}

# Case 3: 4x4 rectangle distances, k=1
{"k":1,"dist":[[0,5,3,4],[5,0,4,3],[3,4,0,5],[4,3,5,0]]}
@ Each point connects to its single closest neighbor
{"idx":[[2],[3],[0],[1]],"dist":[[3],[3],[3],[3]]}

# Case 4: 4x4 rectangle distances, k=2
{"k":2,"dist":[[0,5,3,4],[5,0,4,3],[3,4,0,5],[4,3,5,0]]}
@ Each point connects to its two closest neighbors
{"idx":[[2,3],[3,2],[0,1],[1,0]],"dist":[[3,4],[3,4],[3,4],[3,4]]}

# Case 5: k larger than N-1 (clamped), N=3
{"k":5,"dist":[[0,1,2],[1,0,3],[2,3,0]]}
@ k should be clamped to 2 → same result as Case 2
{"idx":[[1,2],[0,2],[0,1]],"dist":[[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]]}
